nodes.name: Sklearn Inspection Partial-Dependence Task-Guard Atoms
nodes.description: Deterministic estimator-kind and recursion-response guards that run before partial_dependence reaches estimator callback execution.

nodes.name: partial_dependence_require_classifier_or_regressor
nodes.description: Require the fitted estimator task kind to be either classifier or regressor before partial dependence proceeds.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The function executes in constant time and space as it only performs simple validation checks, variable assignments, or returns inputs.
